conditions: Isolated fresh browser HTTP context; same-context cache across cycles. OS and driver caches not cleared. Ordinary UI, native RAF, no race performance claims. Explicit GC/CDP counters are lifecycle diagnostics, not benchmark sampling; texture/geometry/program counts are logical objects, not VRAM. Forced 503/cancel are deliberate failure injection and do not touch owner saves. Ready means rendered start menu; driving tick is separate.
